Package org.aristonis.diwan.database

Interface TransactionScope

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable, Connection
public interface TransactionScope extends Connection, AutoCloseable
Holds a transaction open until it is committed or closed, for use with try-with-resources.

close() rolls back when commit() was not called or failed. Closing twice does nothing. Any call after the scope ended fails with IllegalStateException. Closing an outer scope while an inner one is open ends the inner one first. A scope belongs to the thread that created it and is not thread-safe.
